Dual-label resolution (queue+finding): **promoted to `pm:queue`** (finding stripped). Filed as a "checklist decision", but the deciding ruling already exists in the contract: `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:341` (verified `origin/main` @ `6a9dec6`) declares `notifications` a retired dialect with no translation group, and #3403 moved notification copy to app-authored flows. Rewrite-vs-waive of c0/c4 is a checklist-author judgment inside the devx lane, not a maintainer product call — the #4829 rule (a made decision does not go back to the inbox) applies. `domain:devx` stands.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (devx seat, 2026-08-11 term) — wave 3 unit C, packed with #7686 (same i18n area file; full claim block on #7686). Branch `claude/issue-7686-7684-i18n-checklist`; session `session_01GZKbx4xyF7U5WXj6ch49BM`; `mode:cloud`, `model: opus`.

**PM ruling on this card's "rewrite or waive c0/c4" fork (third-tier, premise-hinged):** REWRITE — restate c0/c4 against the shipped contract: the notification title is the flow-authored literal string (per-recipient localization is a spec-retired capability, `translation.zod.ts:341` guidance quoted in the body; `sys_user` has no locale; #3403 moved assignment notifications to app-authored flows), keep the mechanical clear-half clauses as the item's substance, and record the retirement citation in the item so the next author does not re-assert the retired premise. Premise the ruling hangs on (dev verifies before editing, fork-report if false): the `notifications` translation-key retirement guidance is still on `origin/main` and no notification-copy translation group has since been introduced. Startup-scope lens: prefer asserting the real contract over waiving into silence — a waived clause teaches nothing; a rewritten one pins the retirement.

Pointer comment — this card was packed with #7686 (same i18n area file, one branch, one PR). **The full os-dev report is on #7686**: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/7686#issuecomment-5252808770

Draft PR: **#7715** (`claude/issue-7686-7684-i18n-checklist`), body opens `Fixes #7686` / `Fixes #7684`.

**What this card got — the PM ruling's REWRITE, carried out.** Verified against `origin/main` @ `21888ab` **before** editing, as the ruling required:

- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:341` still carries the retirement guidance verbatim — "`notifications` is the retired object-first dialect — notifications have no translation group, omit them";
- `sys_user` declares no `locale` field;
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts` computes the title as `interpolate(cfg.title …)` against flow variables, with no locale consulted anywhere on that path;
- `collab.assignment` survives only in regression pins asserting the kernel does **not** emit it (#3403, `plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.test.ts`).

No notification-copy translation group has appeared, so the fork condition did not trigger and no fork-report was warranted.

The edits on `i18n.notification-localized-and-clears` (revision 2 → 3):

- **c0** now asserts the title is the **flow-authored literal string with its `{record.*}` placeholders interpolated** — an English title on a Chinese session is the PASS; an unsubstituted placeholder is the FAIL. Interpolation, not translation, is what the clause tests.
- **c4** now asserts the title is recipient-**INDEPENDENT** — a per-recipient *difference* is the finding, since per-recipient localization of app-flow notification copy is the retired capability.
- **c2/c3 untouched** — the live-server `POST /notifications/read` trace and the survives-a-full-reload re-read remain the item's substance, exactly as ruled.
- The retirement is **cited on the item** (`fixtures.knownGaps` + `source`) so the next author cannot re-assert the premise, and two negatives were added: filing a bug over the English bell title is the misread this item now forecloses, and authoring a `notifications` key to "fix" it is a FAIL of the fix.
- The steps drop the unperformable "set the recipient user's locale" (no such field) for the session-locale procedure, and name the showcase flow's `task.assigned` notify node instead of the retired `collab.assignment` trigger.

**One refinement worth the PM's eye, recorded on the item rather than glossed:** `plugin-audit`'s `collab.mention` writer *does* resolve a per-recipient title (`messages.mentionedYou` via `resolveWriteLocale(tenantId, uid)`) — through the long-declared `messages` group, from a plugin writer, not the flow notify path and not a `notifications` group. Stating "notification titles are never localized" unqualified would have been the mirror of the error this card fixes, so both directions are pinned in `knownGaps`.
